description: Journey 1: a new workspace's first apply. Preflight found nothing that uses legacy access; the plan guard flags the Starter warehouse becoming admins only. The table names what people will use.
plan_guard:
Needs approval: 1 change
  - REMOVE everyone's access to the Starter warehouse but the platform admins': check nobody relies on it (queries, dashboards, alerts), or set starter_warehouse.admins_only: null
      module.compute.databricks_permissions.starter_warehouse["2cd38f111de7ce99"]

Not flagged, with the evidence:
  - DISABLE legacy access (Hive metastore), on a workspace where it is not managed yet. Preflight found nothing that still uses it (Hive metastore, DBFS mounts, legacy clusters), so it is not flagged. ONE-WAY after 30 days.
      module.workspace_settings.databricks_disable_legacy_access_setting.this[0]
